card.name: A Cat of Ill Omen
card.officialEffect: FLIP: Choose 1 Trap from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck, or, if "Necrovalley" is on the field, you can add that Trap to your hand instead.

design.physicalOwner: The FLIP source UID identifies the physical seat; the adapter searches and returns the selected copy to that seat's active core or reserve Deck/hand.
design.target: Only cards whose registry metadata kind is trap are eligible; Spell and Monster cards are excluded.
design.selection: The chosen copy is identified by UID plus ID, so multiple copies with the same passcode remain distinct.
design.defaultDestination: Index 0, matching the draw engine's Array.shift() top-of-deck convention.
design.optionalDestination: A hand destination is accepted only when Necrovalley is face-up in either team's Field Zone at resolution; the choice is optional and does not force the hand destination.
design.timing: Necrovalley is read at resolution; adding or removing it between target selection and resolution changes whether the hand option is legal.
design.conservation: The same UID/ID moves from the physical owner's Deck to Deck top or the same owner's hand; no card is created or granted.
design.privacy: The adapter only exposes eligible IDs from the source's physical Deck; it does not inspect or reveal the other seats' Decks.

tests: active physical owner filters the Deck to Trap cards only
without Necrovalley the selected Trap is placed at Deck index 0
face-up Necrovalley on either team's Field Zone allows the optional hand destination
Necrovalley presence is evaluated at resolution, not target-list creation
removing Necrovalley before resolution removes the hand option
face-down Necrovalley does not allow the hand destination
inactive physical owner searches and receives the Trap in their reserve Deck/hand
active physical owner routes through the shared team core
no eligible Trap resolves as no-target without changing inventory
a Trap from a teammate's or another physical seat's Deck is rejected
source identity, face-up state and team ownership are enforced
stale or mismatched FLIP events are rejected
UID/ID inventory is conserved and the input state remains immutable
selected Trap must still be in the physical Deck at resolution
invalid destination is rejected and Necrovalley does not force the hand choice
duplicate source UID and malformed physical-seat UID fail closed
same-ID Trap copies remain distinguishable by physical UID

certification.reason: Adapter preparation only. No resolver/metadata/certification/manifest/allowlist change; M61 handoff remains pending.

limitations: The card is not yet registered in the shared playable-card catalog; tests inject a narrow lookup fixture.
The adapter is not wired into FLIP resolution or the resolver archive and therefore does not certify the card.
Offline structural TagDuel tests do not replace a full engine duel or live Discord guild validation.
